mentions.name: Plausible Game
mentions.description: A daily asynchronous version of the dictionary game in which players try to spot the real definition of an obscure word among fake definitions submitted by other players the previous day, with fake definitions ranked on a daily leaderboard. The async, global format makes the traditional parlor game more casual and accessible; it has been live for about a month with roughly 100 daily players, 5000 total, and some 20 people on 10-day streaks.
mentions.problem: The traditional version of the dictionary game is hard to get a session going.
mentions.audience: Casual players worldwide who want to play the dictionary game asynchronously instead of organizing live sessions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A daily, async version of the dictionary game.

Each day, players try to spot the real definition of an obscure word among the fakes submitted by other players the day before. Fake definitions rank on a daily leaderboard.

I love the traditional version of the game, but it's not so easy to get a session going. An asynchronous, global format is my attempt to make it more casual and accessible.
